_comment: Звуки постановок уникальных карт (ElevenLabs sound-generation): имя -> text (описание звука), duration (сек), influence (0..1, насколько строго следовать описанию). Генерация: tools/voice_gen.gd --sfx=<имя> или --sfx=all -> assets/sfx/fx/<имя>.mp3.

red_dragon_rumble.text: Deep low earth rumble slowly building, distant heavy footsteps of a giant beast, ominous dark fantasy tension, no music

red_dragon_roar.text: Massive ancient dragon roar, deep guttural monstrous growl rising into a thunderous bellow with rasping fire in the throat, dark fantasy, cinematic, close

red_dragon_wings.text: Giant leathery dragon wings beating three times overhead, heavy whooshes of wind passing from right to left, flapping cloth membrane, cinematic

red_dragon_breath.text: Dragon fire breath torrent, roaring blast of flames sweeping past, crackling fire and rushing air, cinematic
